name: What is involved in the cabinet installation process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the cabinet installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our cabinet installation process begins with an initial consultation and measurement. Once cabinets are ordered and delivered, we prepare the space by ensuring walls are level and plumbing/electrical are ready. Installation involves securely mounting base cabinets, followed by upper cabinets, and then installing doors, drawers, and hardware. We finish with a final inspection and cleanup.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, site preparation, mounting base and upper cabinets, installing hardware, and a final inspection.
